hiringTracks.title: Technical Hiring Track
hiringTracks.subtitle: For engineers, IT professionals & diploma-qualified technicians

steps.title: Requirement & Qualification Mapping
steps.body: We map your role against the specific degree, diploma, or certification the destination country requires.

steps.title: Credential Verification
steps.body: Educational and professional credentials are verified and, where required, prepared for recognition (e.g. Germany's qualification recognition process).

steps.title: Technical Assessment & Client Interview
steps.body: Candidates complete a technical assessment or project review, followed by direct interview access for your engineering or IT leads.

steps.title: Visa Sponsorship & Compliance
steps.body: We manage EU Blue Card, Specialist/Engineer visa, or equivalent sponsorship documentation on your behalf.

steps.title: Onboarding & Deployment
steps.body: Technical readiness briefing and workplace-specific onboarding support, followed by deployment to your site.

steps.title: Requirement & Trade Mapping
steps.body: We confirm the exact trade, headcount, and experience level required for your job order.

steps.title: Screening & Trade Certification Check
steps.body: Candidates are shortlisted from our verified pool and checked against trade certificates (ITI or equivalent) and prior work experience.

steps.title: Skill Test & Medical Fitness
steps.body: Hands-on skill testing and medical fitness checks are completed before candidates are confirmed for your order.

steps.title: Visa & Work Permit Processing
steps.body: We handle work permits, police clearance, and all visa documentation required for deployment.

steps.title: Pre-Deployment Training & Deployment
steps.body: Language basics, cultural orientation, and workplace safety briefing precede travel and on-site handover.

engagementModels.title: Bulk Workforce Orders
engagementModels.body: For headcounts of 10 or more, sourced and deployed in phased or single batches aligned to your project timeline.

engagementModels.title: Single & Specialist Hires
engagementModels.body: For individual technical or leadership roles where precise qualification matching matters more than volume.

engagementModels.title: Direct Placement
engagementModels.body: Workers are hired directly onto your payroll under your employment contract, with us managing sourcing and compliance only.

engagementModels.title: Ongoing Contract Staffing
engagementModels.body: We remain the employer of record for the contract duration, giving you workforce flexibility without direct HR overhead.
